overview_description.description: Kebra provides AI software for field service and residential services companies. Its agents capture technician audio, notes, images, and job details, then turn that information into service records, customer communications, parts orders, billing updates, and warranty claims. The platform connects field information with systems such as service-management, accounting, supplier, email, messaging, and warranty portals. Kebra also provides a customer-specific Company Brain that organizes authorized business information for retrieval and workflow automation.
